title: DevBoard — Multi-Tenant Project Management SaaS
desc: A multi-tenant project management platform featuring workspace- and project-level role-based access control, asynchronous workflow automation, and real-time updates. Built secure HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks with retry handling and GitHub integration. Includes 51 cross-tenant isolation tests, 76 automated CI tests, and Docker-based deployment workflows.

title: IELTS Preparation App
desc: A web-based IELTS preparation application featuring reading, writing, and vocabulary practice modules. Implemented user authentication and data management using Firebase, with a responsive interface built using React and Tailwind CSS.

title: I-SORT — Autonomous Product Sorting Robot
desc: An IoT-enabled autonomous sorting robot designed for e-commerce warehouse operations. Worked on automated product classification and sorting workflows, combining embedded systems, Python, and hardware integration to explore warehouse automation and product tracking.

title: Human Disease Prediction — Machine Learning Project
desc: An experimental machine-learning application using Support Vector Machines (SVM) to explore disease-category prediction from user-provided symptoms. The project covers data preprocessing, classification, and model evaluation through a web interface.

title: Car Dealer — Inventory & Sales Management
desc: A Django-based web application for managing vehicle listings, inventory, and sales-related workflows. Developed features for organizing vehicle information and supporting dealership operations through a database-driven interface.

title: Personal Portfolio — Next.js Website
desc: A responsive portfolio website built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features reusable components, animated interactions, dark-mode support, structured project data, and static deployment through GitHub Pages.

title: GeoFence Event Service — Vehicle Zone-Tracking Backend
desc: Backend service tracking vehicles against geofences, emitting idempotent enter/exit events via PostGIS spatial queries with GiST indexing — batch position ingestion, stateful transition detection, and a documented, deployed REST API.
